job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities



Design, build, and deploy applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine tuning of LLM, SLMs & building from scratch
Develop and optimize prompt engineering strategies to improve model performance and reliability.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Design and implement Agentic AI workflows capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool usage.
Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and external tools.
Fine-tune and customize foundation models for domain-specific use cases.
Develop evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, latency, hallucination rates, and user experience.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Ensure scalability, security, observability, and cost optimization of AI systems.
Stay updated with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and emerging LLM technologies.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices.
Experience working with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or similar models.
Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering and Prompt Optimization.
Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, or FAISS.
Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
Experience integrating REST APIs, databases, and external tools into AI workflows.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understanding of NLP, Machine Learning, and AI system design principles.

Preferred Skills

Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs.
Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks and benchmarking methodologies.
Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Experience building multi-agent systems and autonomous AI agents.
Exposure to speech AI, voice assistants, or conversational AI platforms.
